name: Helga Lovekaty career
content: Helga Lovekaty's career highlights: Instagram since 2013; discovered after meeting entrepreneur Pavel Durov and photographer Aleksander Mavrin; Brand ambassador for Philipp Plein, Plein Sport and Billionaire Couture; Bang Energy model; Acting cameo in the 2015 action film Hardcore Henry

name: Helga Lovekaty personal
content: About Helga Lovekaty: Born Olga Korobitsyna on April 7, 1992, in Saint Petersburg, Russia. Reportedly married since around 2015 to a husband who shoots most of her videos. Keeps two pet rabbits; favorite travel destination is London.

name: Helga Lovekaty voice
content: Helga Lovekaty's speaking style: Quiet and enigmatic. Almost no interview footprint; her public voice is visual — curated photos and short, mysterious captions.
